draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 27 ottobre 2026
draft.excerpt: Azzurrini in grande spolvero e talenti che salgono di categoria: la giornata accende i riflettori sulla filiera dei giovani azzurri.
draft.excerptEn: Young Italians in great form and talents climbing the ranks: the day shines a spotlight on the pipeline of young Italian players.
draft.bodyIt:
**Under 20 Italia**
Gli azzurrini continuano il loro cammino senza sbavature: travolto Hong Kong con un robusto 7-2 in una gara dove il controllo non è mai venuto meno. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Primavera 1**
Dalla vivaio alla Nazionale: quattro talenti cresciuti nelle giovanili sono già diventati campioni azzurri, modello di una filiera che funziona. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Pietro Comuzzo**
L'Under 21 di Baldini non lesina gli elogi per il talento della difesa azzurra: il confronto con le prestazioni al Torino diventa inevitabile. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPX2pVUUlkaE9FWHNPVG9XRXhQSlFWZHNfVEJ4SjZhU281VnpXWkZKNGNmb1FDVkc0ZFBBczdDRU41blJ6WWhkLUlIX1pMX3BlUnFWNUpMMkxiX3UwNHRNSHBrOHVabHoxS0JuYlRHN1Mwbi1KOEZwWjViTlBYSHBSY0h2ZlBpTnVwSEZqaU9nM0tieU5abWc?oc=5)

**Alessandro Longoni**
Il giovane portiere italiano alla ricerca di continuità al PSG: dopo un periodo di difficoltà, inizia finalmente a intravedere la luce. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPUlhoN3o2U29Vc1NiaDZnWnQtOXJsUktYMEpweE5EQUpsTG5WUVRWZjYzYjdyR3ZoVXlsNEtpM2RidF9UZno4b1M1NUhsX3UwWnA1VkI4VzdDWkRqdkJtVC1JSXBIcGM2X0dkSkJiRFBWTFRzUnZMUS1zc3BFZmFVT3gwZTZydjlPMl9mSUJpQWtlM1hpQnpTazBBYXdWRXFfRC11elhwTHp2UQ?oc=5)

**Special Olympics**
Tre talenti italiani tra cui Rietinclude, Lalli e Petrucci ricevono la convocazione per i Giochi Mondiali Special Olympics: un traguardo importante per loro. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

Una giornata che conferma il lavoro quotidiano nei vivai e nelle categorie giovanili azzurre.
draft.bodyEn:
**Under 20 Italy**
The young Italians continue their flawless run: they steamrolled Hong Kong 7-2 in a match where control never wavered. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Primavera 1**
From the academy to the National team: four talents raised in the youth ranks have already become Italian champions, a model of an effective pipeline. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Pietro Comuzzo**
Baldini's Under 21 squad reserves high praise for the young defender: comparisons with his performances at Torino are inevitable. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPX2pVUUlkaE9FWHNPVG9XRXhQSlFWZHNfVEJ4SjZhU281VnpXWkZKNGNmb1FDVkc0ZFBBczdDRU41blJ6WWhkLUlIX1pMX3BlUnFWNUpMMkxiX3UwNHRNSHBrOHVabHoxS0JuYlRHN1Mwbi1KOEZwWjViTlBYSHBSY0h2ZlBpTnVwSEZqaU9nM0tieU5abWc?oc=5)

**Alessandro Longoni**
The young Italian goalkeeper is seeking consistency at PSG: after a difficult spell, he is finally beginning to see the light. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPUlhoN3o2U29Vc1NiaDZnWnQtOXJsUktYMEpweE5EQUpsTG5WUVRWZjYzYjdyR3ZoVXlsNEtpM2RidF9UZno4b1M1NUhsX3UwWnA1VkI4VzdDWkRqdkJtVC1JSXBIcGM2X0dkSkJiRFBWTFRzUnZMUS1zc3BFZmFVT3gwZTZydjlPMl9mSUJpQWtlM1hpQnpTazBBYXdWRXFfRC11elhwTHp2UQ?oc=5)

**Special Olympics**
Three Italian talents including Rietinclude, Lalli and Petrucci receive their callup for the Special Olympics World Games: a significant milestone for them. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

A day that confirms the daily work carried out in academies and young Italian categories.
